verdict.rationale: Claude Code/Skills evidence shows genuine task-delegation to a built-in AI assistant: subagents, agent teams, background 'agent view', and an Agent SDK for building autonomous agents, plus skills that let Claude autonomously invoke bundled tools/scripts. However, multiple community reports describe skills/agent delegation as unreliable — agents 'just don't use them without being asked,' triggering is 'hit or miss,' and some users had to bypass the mechanism by pasting instructions into AGENTS.md — a real caveat on how dependably delegation works in practice. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks confirming reliable autonomous delegation, and resolution of the widely reported triggering inconsistency.
